role: Referencja wojownika do jednego testowego zadania image-to-3D Meshy
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single clean character reference image specifically for Meshy image-to-3D, for the gothic-anime art direction of Turris Damnatorum.
Reference image: use ONLY its knight's visual language and palette. Remove all environment and gameplay framing.
Subject: ONE adult male gothic knight, entire body from crown of helmet to soles fully visible with generous margins, straight-on front view with only a very slight 10-degree three-quarter turn. Neutral symmetrical A-pose, feet shoulder-width, legs straight, arms angled about 35 degrees from torso, hands empty and half-open, fingers clearly separated and relaxed. Orthographic-like long-lens view, no foreshortening.
Design: mature heroic human proportions, about 7.5 heads tall, athletic rather than bulky. Enclosed simple pointed gothic sallet helmet with dark narrow visor. Broad clean ivory-silver steel armor plates: breastplate, layered but restrained pauldrons, forearm bracers, fitted gauntlets, knees and shin plates, dark navy undergarment. Small muted gold trim at a few major edges, one burgundy waistcloth split into front and back panels above the knees, simple dark leather belt. Short, anatomically proportioned rigid steel boots with flat soles; no long beak toes. Clear joints and gaps for animation. No long cape hiding the back or legs. No weapon or shield attached anywhere.
Style: elegant gothic anime game character, polished three-dimensional stylized design, economical broad shapes, sparse thin contour lines, two to three clean shading bands, sharp clear material color boundaries, very little texture detail. Armor feels like steel through broad graphic highlights, not realistic scratches or photorealistic PBR. No tiny ornaments, no embossed filigree, no readable insignia.
Background and light: pure very light neutral gray or white backdrop, evenly lit neutral studio light, no dramatic side lighting, no cast floor shadow, no environment, no ground plane, no pedestal. Solid-color opaque image.
Constraints: exactly one character, no duplicate views, no contact sheet, no inset panels, no labels, no text, no floating effects, no props, no weapon, no shield, no watermark. Portrait composition. Match a clean sculptable riggable character reference, not a dramatic illustration.
